summary: User-reported while validating MPI-436: 8K sources lag the Adjust sliders. This is the ceiling MPI-436 shipped with a ponytail: comment naming the fix - 1563ms first move and 64ms per frame at 4096, against 247/7 at 2048. Filed under the MPI-440 umbrella. The trap is written into the card: a fix that only defers the 1563ms leaves the drag at 15fps, so both numbers must fall.
